summary: metal : few-row MMA mat-mul for the remaining src0 types ( #30065 ) The generic few-row MMA kernel works for any type with a 16-weight dequantizer, so it now also takes BF16, Q1_0, Q2_0, MXFP4, Q2_K, Q3_K, TQ2_0 and the IQ types. Each type starts at the row count where it beats the current kernels on an M3 Ultra: 5 rows for TQ2_0, 4 for BF16, 3 for MXFP4, Q2_0, Q2_K and IQ4_NL, and 2 for the others. test-backend-ops
body:
metal : few-row MMA mat-mul for the remaining src0 types ( #30065 )

The generic few-row MMA kernel works for any type with a 16-weight

dequantizer, so it now also takes BF16, Q1_0, Q2_0, MXFP4, Q2_K, Q3_K,

TQ2_0 and the IQ types. Each type starts at the row count where it beats

the current kernels on an M3 Ultra: 5 rows for TQ2_0, 4 for BF16, 3

for MXFP4, Q2_0, Q2_K and IQ4_NL, and 2 for the others.

test-backend-ops perf -o MUL_MAT, m=4096, k=14336, M3 Ultra, time of this

change over master (mean of two interleaved runs each): 0.23 to 0.98 from

the threshold to 8 rows, 0.24 to 0.33 at 9 to 16 rows, and 0.99 to 1.01 at

summaryZh: llama.cpp 项目发布新版本（commit b11476），主要在 Metal 后端为剩余的 src0 类型引入了通用少行 MMA（Matrix Multiply-Accumulate）矩阵乘法内核（#30065）。该通用内核适用于任何带有 16 权重反量化器的类型，现已支持 BF16、Q1_0、Q2_0、MXFP4、Q2_K、Q3_K、TQ2_0 及各种 IQ 类型，在 M3 Ultra 等苹果芯片上显著提升了推理计算效率并给出了详细性能基准。
